_doc: Per-language filler data for transcribe.py. prompt: punctuated verbatim text with fillers, so Whisper keeps fillers and punctuation instead of cleaning them. always: fillers marked anywhere (single words or phrases). contextual: words that are fillers only when followed by a comma/ellipsis or a pause. restart: phrases a speaker uses when redoing a take. Add a language by copying an entry; codes are the ones passed to --lang.

es.prompt: Ehm, bueno, este... o sea, la verdad es que, eh, no sé. Mmm, digamos que sí, ¿viste?

en.prompt: Um, so, uh... I mean, like, you know, it's, hmm, basically fine. Yeah.

pt.prompt: Éh, então, tipo... né, assim, ahn, sabe? Hum, bom, é isso.
